answer: Resist sybils by making franchise expensive and delayed. A new key can appear in a hollow registration slot, but it cannot grade, vote, or draw a full emission share until it posts original word-locked answers that peers attest and a jury passes across successive epochs. That climb is the canyon: each fake identity needs distinct prose, because copies are rejected and a failing grade buys no progress. Establishment then expires on a TTL if the work stops, so a one-shot farm cannot keep seats. The nectar of payouts and jury power stays with keys that already paid that recurring cost.
